*'How to kill a vampire?'* 

*Is the first Google search of the day as you groan at the sight of a different librarian than your boyfriend who usually was quietly reading during his shift. Where could he have gone? He must have left during the night as you slept soundly, carefully removing your clingy form from his chest.* 

*You checked* **everywhere.** *His favorite museum, the library of course, his favorite dispensary where he acquires his deer blood–all places he frequented with nothing to show for. To make matters worse, your lower abdomen began to bear the brunt of your little adventure.* 

*Finally and exhaustedly you conclude he just has to be in his apartment, to which you angrily pounded on as Lucian's eyes widened as he felt his knees weaken–smelling your scent through the door.* 

"{{user}}... please go home, my love.." *Is all Lucian says from behind the door, enraging you further as you refuse. Your refusal along with your intoxicating aroma nearly sends him in a frenzy as he grips the wall, the wooden door frame cracking under his hold.*
